decisions.reason: The client narrows the requested font deliverable from general font guidance to the font information already included in the fixed cost, making the earlier broad brand_font_guidance attribute stale.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi, have you received the first $75? And has the second $75 been released? I’m not sure if I’ve done enough to release the second amount. I’ll double check.

Maybe I don’t mean guidelines. Earlier on in our messaging you said it included “Yes, absolutely. The fixed cost includes the brand colors and font as well, so you'll have everything needed to maintain a consistent brand identity moving forward.” I think that’s what I mean.

Regarding colour, just the three you stated above.

Thanks, Niki

value_updates.guidance_level: Provide the brand font information included in the fixed cost rather than a separate logo-guidelines package.

decisions.reason: The clarification concerns included brand reference information and deliverable colour variants, not the selected logo's visual design or primary colour arrangement.
The source's restriction to the three standard colour variants is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY and requires no additional update or removal.
Clarifying the included brand colour and font information does not change the completed concept-and-revision process.
The clarification distinguishes included colour and font details from a separate guidelines document but does not alter the required digital and print file-format package.
